newsitem.title: POLAND: KREDYT PLANS UP TO 25 MLN NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: KREDYT PLANS UP TO 25 MLN NEW SHARES.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank SA plans to issue 15 million to 25 million new shares ex-rights with part of them possibly going toward Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) or American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), the bank said.
Kredyt Bank said in a statement on Tuesday that the issue would be voted on at a general shareholders meeting on May 28.
It said funds from the issue would be used for its planned merger with Polish Investment Bank (PBI) and to help it become one of Poland's 10 largest banks.

Kredyt said the new shares would be offered in three tranches, one each for current shareholders, selected large investors not engaging in activities competing with the bank and a public offering for individuals.
The bank said the number of shares in the tranches would be set later and that some shares in the large investor tranche could be earmarked for GDRs or ADRs.
The bank currently has 36,478,304 shares outstanding.
